```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
})

here::i_am("2_SnC_cell_analysis/heatmap_SnC_vs_nonSnC_FC.Rmd")
```

## Clusters of interest
```{r}
SnC_clusters <- c("Fibroblast", "Pericyte_SMC", "Lymphatic_endo", "Endo_vein2")
tissue <- "fibroid"
```


## SnC vs non-SnC Findmarkers result thresholded on p-value and FC
```{r}
de_genes_list <- lapply(SnC_clusters, function(clust) {
  SnC.genes <- read.csv(here::here("results", "2_SnC-vs-nonSnC", tissue, paste0(tissue, ".", clust, ".SnC.genes.csv")), row.names = 1)
  SnC.genes <- SnC.genes %>%
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.3) %>%
    rownames_to_column()
})
names(de_genes_list) <- SnC_clusters
```

```{r}
de_genes_interesting <- list_rbind(de_genes_list, names_to = "cell_type") 
de_genes_interesting$cell_type <- paste0("SnC.", de_genes_interesting$cell_type)
```

## Create LFC data matrix to plot
```{r}
dat.wide <- de_genes_interesting %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = rowname, 
              names_from = cell_type, 
              values_from = avg_log2FC) %>%
  column_to_rownames()

dat.wide[is.na(dat.wide)] <- 0

head(dat.wide)
```


# Heatmap annotation
## Column annotation
```{r}
#Cell type 
celltype <- colnames(dat.wide)
names(celltype) <- celltype
celltype

cell_col <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#FFCB57", "#00EEB0")
names(cell_col) <- c("SnC.Fibroblast", "SnC.Pericyte_SMC", "SnC.Lymphatic_endo", "SnC.Endo_vein2")
cell_col

sample_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Celltype = celltype,
  col = list(Celltype = cell_col)
)
```

## Row annotation
```{r}
ann <- de_genes_interesting %>%
  select(c(rowname, cpdb.secreted, Surfaceome, Division)) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(Matrisome = ! is.na(Division))
rownames(ann) <- ann$rowname

#Split heatmap into Secreted Signaling/Other
ann$split <- ifelse(ann$cpdb.secreted, "Secreted Signaling", "Other")


all(rownames(ann) == rownames(dat.wide))
head(ann)

sec <- c("whitesmoke", "#FFFF33")
names(sec) <- c("FALSE", "TRUE")

surface <- c("white", "#F781BF")
names(surface) <- c("FALSE", "TRUE")

matri <- c("white", "#984EA3")
names(matri) <- c("FALSE", "TRUE")

gene_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  Secreted.signaling = ann$cpdb.secreted, 
  Surface = ann$Surfaceome, 
  Matrisome = ann$Matrisome,
  col = list(Secreted.signaling = sec,
             Surface = surface,
             Matrisome = matri),
  annotation_name_side = "top"
)

```

## Heatmap
```{r}
ht <- Heatmap(as.matrix(dat.wide), 
        col = colorRamp2(c(-2.5, 0, 2.5), colors = c("#3B4CC0", "whitesmoke", "#B40426")), 
        name = "avg_log2FC", 
        show_column_names = F, 
        show_row_names = F,
        top_annotation = sample_anno, 
        left_annotation = gene_anno,
        cluster_columns = T, 
        cluster_rows = T, 
        show_row_dend = F, 
        show_column_dend = F,
        column_title_rot = 50,
        row_title_rot = 0,
        row_split = ann$split,
        row_gap = unit(3, "mm"),
        #row_title = c("", ""),
        column_split = celltype
)
```

## Save plot
```{r, fig.height=10}
#pdf(here::here("results", "figures", "Fig_2", "Heatmap.SnC_vs_nonSnC_FC.pdf"), width = 8, height = 13)
ht
#dev.off()
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
})

```
